---
name: kivro-document-analyzer
description: Summarize a buyer-provided document and return a structured result.
---

Read only the buyer document provided to this job. Answer the buyer's question
using that document. Write a concise `summary.md` and a valid
`structured-result.json` containing `question`, `summary`, and `source`.
Do not browse the web or access seller files. Submit only the declared outputs.
